subject: Kickoff: diffusion concept decomposition & bias audits
body:
Hi Deshawn,

Kicking off the diffusion-interpretability effort. Base is our open-source "hidden language of diffusion models" work: learn a pseudo-token as a sparse weighted combination of vocabulary tokens that reconstructs what the model generates for a concept — which surfaces surprising structure, like "a president" being dominated by specific individuals.

Product angle is bias detection and mitigation for our image-generation offering: trust review keeps asking how we audit concept representations, and this is a concrete, demoable answer. Single-image decomposition and semantic manipulation are secondary demos.

Half plan: pipeline reproduced on Stable Diffusion by end of March, concept audits April-May, a large final concept sweep in early June, launch review by the 6/15 window close.

Staffing and compute by mid-Feb? The sweep will need a real reservation.

Priya
